name: Lemon balm
short: Two meta-analyses of randomised trials (anxiety and depression; cardiometabolic outcomes) reported no serious side effects, but the trials were few and often at high risk of bias.
text: A meta-analysis of randomised trials of lemon balm for anxiety and depression reported improvements without serious side effects, while noting the small number of trials and the differences between their methods. A second meta-analysis of seven randomised trials looking at cardiometabolic outcomes reported no serious adverse events, with a high risk of bias in a considerable number of the studies. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
